compute_varint_size: compute the byte size of a varint encoded integer value using _VarintSize
compute_signed_varint_size: compute the byte size of a signed varint value using _SignedVarintSize
encode_varint_bytes: encode an integer as varint bytes using _VarintBytes for startup-time tag generation
encode_tag_bytes: encode a field number and wire type into tag bytes using TagBytes
build_field_sizer: build a sizer function for a protobuf field type using Int32Sizer or StringSizer
